text: Completed on codex/multivar-lifecycle at c44d634 (stacked on bf7f82c). Added a GLRM-agnostic family-indexed lifecycle kernel: checked FamilyContract, typed ProgramId/CompiledId/ResultId/TrainingScopeId, FitBinding retaining declared and lowered execution program identities, ModelProgram/CompiledModel/ModelWorkflow stages, non-empty certificates, sealed SolverReceipt, bound SolverEvidence, private-constructor FittedModel, and explicit CanTransform/CanEncode/CanReconstruct capabilities. Added exact-spectral declared/compiled adapters and an ExactSpectralReceipt over existing OperatorProgramFit/OperatorFitBundle with no numerical recomputation. Centralized OperatorProgram.valueIdentity and made exact quadratic/null-space compilers request ExactGlobal explicitly once their exact rewrite path is selected. Laws prove cross-family IDs/stages fail compilation, FittedModel cannot be constructed publicly, foreign payloads fail binding, receipt/guarantee/certificate/scope/program/data/result identities coincide, numerical results are preserved, and absent capabilities do not compile. Evidence: full multivar JVM and JS suites pass (457 each), multivar-ir JVM 46 and JS 44 pass, and sbt compileAll passes.
